title: Interop: cross-check mimi-content vectors with openconv (content-09)
description: Found in survey 2026-11-13 (mimid-1wgh.46.8). nisarsyed/openconv (Rust, MIT, desktop chat app) has its own MIMI content codec in crates/core/src/content.rs pinned to draft-ietf-mimi-content-09 (deterministic CBOR, message id per section 3.3, test against the draft example). Independent of phnx-im and Haven. Cheap check: decode/encode their test vectors with mimid's content crate and compare message ids; note the content-09 -> -10 delta. Last commit 2026-11-01; single author.
